links.outcome: Answer consistency of medical VQA models across paraphrased versions of the same question
links.effect: Models flip answers when the same query is rephrased. Fine-tuning on LLM-augmented paraphrases raised mean answer accuracy by 19.4% and TAR-SC (accuracy plus across-paraphrase agreement) by 11.6%.
links.quote: We confront a critical yet under-studied weakness of Medical Visual Question Answering (MVQA): models often flip their answers when clinicians phrase the same diagnostic query differently.

unlisted_practices: LLM-generated semantically equivalent question augmentation of training data to improve paraphrase robustness of medical VQA models
Joint accuracy and across-paraphrase agreement metric (TAR-SC) for evaluation

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a data augmentation training method (SEQA) to improve consistency of Medical Visual Question Answering models across paraphrased queries, evaluating accuracy and consistency metrics on benchmark datasets.
